final: SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as avg_of_kept_ratios, SUM(record_count) as total_kept_records, AVG(record_count - (SELECT AVG(record_count) FROM (SELECT COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'NULL') as fundflux, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM scanspatial s LEFT JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux))) as avg_excess FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as record_count, AVG(CASE WHEN s.boxy IS NOT NULL AND s.boxz IS NOT NULL AND s.boxz != 0 THEN CAST(s.boxy AS REAL) / CAST(s.boxz AS REAL) ELSE NULL END) as avg_ratio FROM scanspatial s LEFT JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'NULL') HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT AVG(record_count) FROM (SELECT COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'NULL') as fundflux, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM scanspatial s LEFT JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux)))
